verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v1: ʾajībū dāʿiyā l-mawlā ʾajībū faʾinna llāha khāliqukum yujību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v2: yujību ʾidhā daʿawtum ʾaw shakawtum samīʿu yustajābu wayastajību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v3: khuliqtum qablu min ṭīni waṣirtum mulūka l-ʾarḍi fī d-dunyā ʾajībū
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v4: waman lam yashkuri l-mawlā kaṭīni waʾinsāni famawlahu l-mujību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v5: ʾajāba l-ʾanbiyāʾa lakum kamā qad ʾajāba r-rusla fahwa l-mustajību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v6: waqāla khudhū lizīnatikum muqāmā yajūbu ʾilayhi minkum man yajūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v7: wujūdu la yushābihuhu wujūdu wujūdu llāhi khalladahu l-wujūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v8: wajūdu fawqa mā lil-jūdi kammā wakayfā wahwa razzāqu najību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v9: wamallakakum jawāzā kulla shayʾi faʾamsā l-kullu ʿan karami yanūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v10: wadhāka l-ḥubbu ʾaʿjabu mā htadaytum bihi lil-ḥaqqi fal-ʿajabu l-ʿajību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v11: yuḥḥibu liman yuḥḥibu bila ḥisābi wadhāka ʾaḥaqqu mā ḥtasaba l-ḥasību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v12: ḥayātu fī l-ḥaqīqati yartaḍīhā limaḥbūbi yuḥḥabibuhu l-ḥabību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v13: wakullu saʿādati fī l-ḥubbi dhikrā waʾasʿadu dhikrayāti la taghību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v14: waman lam yashqa fīhā fahwa ṭiflu waʾashqāhum liʾasʿadihim ṭabību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v15: wariḍwānu mina l-mawlā naṣību wakhayru kulluhu hadhā n-naṣību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v16: taqarrubukum lahu faḍlu ʿaẓīmu warabbukumu l-mujību huwa l-qarību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v17: takhalluqukum biʾakhlaqi ḥawāhā faʾaṭyabu mā taṭību bihi l-qulūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v18: taṭību bihi l-qulūbu khilala ʾamni wakullu qulūbikum ʾabadā taṭību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v19: wafī l-ʾādābi ʾiḥsānu wafīhā mina l-ʾakhlaqi mā ʿtarafa l-ʾadību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v20: ʾimāmu l-ʾanbiyāʾi wamujtabāhum waʾayyā ʾimāmihim madaḥa r-raqību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v21: bisidrati muntahā waẓilali maʾawā raʾā ʾanna l-qarība huwa l-gharību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v22: wafī baṣari r-rasūli sanā lighaybi wafīhi mina s-sanā ʿalanā ḍurūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v23: jalala llāhi min sharafi liʿabdi ghadā sharafā yuthābu liman yuthību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v24: waʾajmalu man yukhāṭabu ḍimna waḥyi walaw la l-waḥyū sayṭarati dh-dhunūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v25: waʾashjaʿu man taqallada yawma zaḥfi bisayfi ḥīna tushtaʿalu l-ḥurūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v26: waʾakramuhum liḍayfi ʾaw lijāri faqīrā kāna ʾaw shahmā yunību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v27: waʾabqāhum yamīnā lil-barāyā wayumnā fīhimā nashaʾa sh-shuʿūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v29: faʾinna muḥummadā fī kulli qarni rasūlu la yaghību wala yakhību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v30: ʿalayhi mina l-muhaymini yā larabbi ṣalatu kulluhā marʿā khaṣību
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v31: ṣalatu yastafīdu n-nāsu minhā kakhayri la tushaqqu bihi l-juyūbu
verses.ajibu-da-iya-l-mawla-ajibu-c1-v28: wa-man yuʾumin fafī l-ʾīmāni ḥilmu waman yakfur fakufrānu waḥūbu
